title: Blessed animal bladders hung on the fence line

tellings.quote: the the the Native Americans have been hanging these and blessing these animal bladders

plain: In 2016, Native Americans were hanging animal bladders along the fence line of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings, and blessing them. Brandon Fugal, presented on the show as the ranch's owner, tells Michels this as something he knows first-hand, and he credits the point to security staff he calls Bigelow security. If true, the local people treated the ranch's border as something that needed spiritual protection.
